# BrilliantR

> AI and IT consulting for small and mid-sized businesses without an in-house IT department. No bloated contracts.

BrilliantR helps small businesses adopt AI and optimize their IT systems. Services are designed to be accessible — no enterprise budget required, no full-time IT hire needed. Every solution is built with security from the ground up.

Contact: hello@brilliantr.com
Location: Lehi, Utah, USA
Website: https://brilliantr.com

## Services

### IT and AI Health Check
$1,500 flat fee. A full audit of your current IT setup, software spend, security posture, and AI opportunities. Delivers a prioritized report with clear ROI estimates. Timeline: 2–3 weeks. Includes kickoff call, full assessment, written report, and review call.

### AI Automation Projects
Custom AI solutions that replace manual workflows, expensive SaaS tools, or repetitive processes. Priced on a shared savings model: fee = 50% of the agreed annual saving, paid upfront. Minimum project floor: $5,000 in annual savings. Solution is deployed on the client's own cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud or AWS) — client owns and controls it.

### Business Intelligence
Natural language dashboards and automated reporting. Clients can query their own data without SQL, a data team, or expensive BI licenses.

### Customer Communication Agents
AI agents that handle inbound enquiries, qualify leads, respond to reviews, and manage appointment booking — 24/7, in any language.

### Document and Invoice Automation
Automated extraction, routing, and processing of invoices, contracts, receipts, and forms. Typical outcome: 80–90% reduction in manual processing time.

### Security-First AI Builds
All solutions are built with security by design — no exposed credentials, no leaky integrations.

## Pricing

| Option | Rate | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Introductory hourly | $120/hr | First 10 hours with any new client. No minimum commitment. |
| Monthly retainer | $1,000/month | 10 hrs/month at $100/hr. 3-month minimum. Unused hours roll over one month. |
| Standard hourly | $150/hr | No commitment. Billed in full-hour increments. |
| IT and AI Health Check | $1,500 flat | Fixed-price audit. |
| AI Automation (ROI sharing) | 50% of annual saving | Paid upfront. Min $5,000 annual saving. |

Payment: ACH bank transfer.

## About the Founder

Security consultant and former professional penetration tester with 10+ years of experience breaking into companies to find vulnerabilities before attackers could. Spent the last 6+ years securing organizations from the inside, currently serving as Director of Security at an 800-person company. Based in Lehi, Utah. Originally from Denmark.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/runetk-dk/

## How the ROI Sharing Model Works

1. Client and BrilliantR identify a specific, measurable cost (a software subscription, a manual workflow, a paid service).
2. The annual value is agreed in writing before any work starts.
3. BrilliantR's fee is exactly 50% of that agreed saving.
4. Payment is made upfront; work begins.
5. The finished solution is deployed on the client's own cloud infrastructure. Client owns it entirely.
